:::{#thm-psd-plus-multiple-identity}
#### Adding a positive multiple of the identity makes a matrix positive definite

Let $\matr{A}$ be a $p \times p$ positive semidefinite matrix (@def-positive-semidefinite)
and let $\combwt > 0$.
Then $\matr{A} + \combwt \matr{I}_p$ is positive definite (@def-positive-definite),
so it is invertible (@thm-pd-invertible).

:::

::: proof

$\matr{A} + \combwt \matr{I}_p$ is symmetric:
its transpose is $\tp{\matr{A}} + \combwt \matr{I}_p = \matr{A} + \combwt \matr{I}_p$
(@thm-transpose-sum, @def-scalar-mult, @def-matrix-transpose).
For $\vx \ne \vzero_p$,

$$
\ba
\tp{\vx}\,(\matr{A} + \combwt \matr{I}_p)\,\vx
&= \qform{\matr{A}}{\vx} + \combwt\,\tp{\vx}\,\matr{I}_p\,\vx
&& \text{(@thm-matmul-distrib, @thm-scalar-matmul)}
\\
&= \qform{\matr{A}}{\vx} + \combwt\,\norm{\vx}^2
&& \text{(@thm-identity, @eq-norm-dot-product, squared)}
\\
&> 0.
&& \text{(} \qform{\matr{A}}{\vx} \ge 0, \; \combwt > 0, \; \vx \ne \vzero_p \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
